parts: Hi Phil -- Do you have any examples of how you determine the degrees for the testinfo function? or if you could direct me to a resource that goes in depth about this? I'm currently trying to get assess item and test information for a five-factor (simple structure) compensatory model.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: testinfo() for multidimensional models
parts:
What do you mean by 'determine the degrees'? The degrees vector is just a vector of normal degrees between 0 and 90, where each value essentially applies a weight argument to collapse the multidimensional information into a scalar value (0 would include the full contribution of a latent trait, while 90 would include no contribution). I think work by Mark Reckase is a good place to look for extra information on this topic. Cheers.

Phil
